pkgmetadata.longdescription: Ocean is Meta's in-house framework for Computer Vision (CV) and Augmented Reality (AR) applications. It is platform-independent and implemented primarily in C/C++, supporting Linux, macOS, Windows, Android, and iOS.

use.flag: Enable HTTPS client support via libcurl in the network module
Build only the base, cv, and math components (no media, IO, network, tracking, etc.)
Enable OpenSSL support for digital signature verification in the IO module
Enable tinyxml2 support for XML parsing in the IO module
